tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search all available engineering tools by name or description. Use this when a task crosses design, meshing, simulation, inference, documents or visualisation; do not limit yourself to the current UI panel. Results are filtered to your permissions.

tools.name: get_capabilities

tools.name: list_projects

tools.name: create_project

tools.name: predict_physics

tools.name: rename_job

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the authenticated user and organisation only when requested. Not a design prerequisite or connection preflight. Never returns a secret key.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Read your usage across entry points, or pooled organisation usage (owner/admin): jobs and the credits they used. Request counts aren't charges.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: Read this key's durable MCP operation metadata with pagination. Restricted keys cannot read other projects; secrets, raw input bodies and signed URLs are never logged.
